_readme: Real completed dryer vent jobs. Run `node scripts/build-content.js` (it also runs on every deploy) and this file becomes projects.html, the individual /projects/<slug>.html pages, and the homepage preview. Add a job here and push - no page editing.
_howToAddAJob: 1. Put the photos in images/projects/ . Name them descriptively, e.g. roof-dryer-vent-cleaning-boynton-beach-fl-1.webp
2. Copy the _example object below into the projects array and fill it in.
3. Push. The build regenerates every page that shows projects.
Only write what actually happened. Leave result/airflow out rather than estimating them, and do not name a city in alt text unless the photo was taken there.

_rules.ownPage: A job gets its own indexable page at /projects/<slug>.html only when it has at least 3 photos AND at least 90 words across problem/found/work/result. Thinner jobs still appear as cards on the index. This keeps thin pages out of the index.
_rules.emptyState: While this array is empty, projects.html is noindex, stays out of the sitemap, and Projects is not shown in the navigation.
_rules.airflow: Only fill airflowBefore/airflowAfter if the readings were actually measured on that job.

_example.title: Severe Dryer Vent Blockage
_example.problem: Homeowner reported long drying times and excessive heat from the dryer.
_example.found: What was actually in the duct when it was opened up.
_example.work: What was performed, including anything that could not be reached and why.
_example.result: What changed. Leave this out if there is nothing measured or observed to report.
